title: simforge.scenario-cell/v1
description: cell.json of a scenario cell (ADR 0008): one compiled point of a matrix (a batch or catalog draw, a variation, a transfer), written beside its scenario.json and input.json (X.cell.json beside X.scenario.json and X.input.json). The scenario stays the single source of content. The cell holds only evidence plus the two matrix options. Nothing that describes the world goes into it later. scenarioSha256 is the sha256 of the scenario.json bytes (canonical JSON of the pinned scenario) and manifest.inputHash the sha256 of the input.json bytes: input.json is the compiled engine input, a derived cache, never hand-edited, regenerated by `simforge cell refresh`, and may be omitted (a reader that needs the input then compiles the scenario, or refuses if it cannot). Every reader checks both bindings before it uses the cache: cell_scenario_mismatch when the scenario no longer hashes to scenarioSha256, cell_input_stale when the cache no longer hashes to manifest.inputHash. mapId, siteId and drawIndex are the scenario's anchor.pin.

scenarioSha256.description: Absent only on a cell migrated (`simforge cell migrate`) from a deleted scenario-instance envelope whose template could not be recovered: such a cell has no scenario.json, is evidence only (its input.json is its input) and cannot be refreshed.

siteId.description: Absent when the scenario pins no site (a scene-absolute scenario).

drawIndex.description: Absent when the scenario pins no draw.

catalogSlot.description: Matrix option: the catalog reservation the cell was compiled for (its attemptSeed seeds the compile, its variant is applied). Present only for catalog cells.

ambientSettleSeconds.description: Matrix option: seconds of ambient-only warm-up before t = 0 (the ambient profile itself is the scenario's extensions["studio.ambientTraffic.profile.v1"]).

manifest.description: The instance manifest of the compile (evidence): inputHash, replayKey, actors, issues, feasibility.
